long_biography.plain_text:
A former model, Rosanna Armani later headed group communications and led Emporio Armani Magazine, which linked the label's collections with art and lifestyle. She joined Giorgio Armani S.p.A.'s board in 2017 and remained a director until the post-succession reconstitution in 2025.

Her brother's will granted her profit rights over Category E stock representing 15% of company capital. Those securities carry no votes, and the Giorgio Armani Foundation retains their underlying title. Rosanna consequently holds inherited economic rights without corporate control or a present board seat. Silvana Armani occupies the continuing family directorship and leads womenswear design, while executives led by Giuseppe Marsocci manage operations. The distinction keeps Rosanna's capital interest separate from the governance, creative and operating responsibilities held by others.
